summary: Teaches a Champion to wind, carry and throw the heaviest bolt of the ballista through shields and timber.

title: Canon of Massed Engine Fire
summary: Trains the commanders of a line of ballistae to space, time and concentrate their fire as one weapon.

title: Advanced Rules of Distant Marks
summary: Teaches a Xiantian shooter to hold breath, eye and wrist still enough to strike a far mark with one bolt.

title: The Long Throw Compendium
summary: Shows how to wind, raise and loose a ballista to the full limit of its reach.

title: Paired Engine Manual of the Azure Basin
summary: Teaches two ballista crews to wind, aim and loose in step, as the basin garrisons are trained.

title: Hawk Eye Treatise on the Twin Sights
summary: Opens the hawk-eyed sighting of the Azure school, with paired pins, wide scanning and a single chosen shot.

title: Rules of the River Line Batteries
summary: Teaches the siting and firing of ballista batteries along a river, from footing in wet ground to closing a ford.

title: Wind-Sworn Handbook of the Deck Engine
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn crews to fire a ballista from a pitching deck against rails, oars and masts.

title: Oath of the Open Plateau Bolt
summary: Teaches the open-plateau shot, where wind is read in the grass and the aim is held by oath through the gusts.

title: Bearing Rules of the Edge Engine
summary: Teaches the shooting of a ballista from a cliff or plateau edge down onto climbers and narrow paths.
